title: Core: AS2 class inheritance and super
description: Verify AS2 class inheritance compiles: class Dog extends Animal { function Dog() { super(); } function speak() { return super.speak() + ' woof'; } }. Verify ActionNew (0x4a), prototype chain setup, and super() calls compile. Also test interface keyword is silently ignored. Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/inheritance.test.ts.
